mapper.select:
select u.id, u.user_name as userName, u.mobile, u.email, u.department_id as departmentId, d.name as departmentName, u.leader_id as leaderId, lu.user_name as leaderName, u.hrbp_id as hrbpId, hu.user_name as hrbpName, u.is_del as isDel from t_user u left join t_department d on u.department_id = d.id left join t_user lu on u.leader_id = lu.id left join t_user hu on u.hrbp_id = hu.id
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
and u.mobile like concat('%', #{mobile}, '%')
order by u.id

select d.id, d.name, d.short_name as shortName, d.parent_id as parentId, pd.name as parentName, d.leader_id as leaderId, lu.user_name as leaderName, d.level, d.sort, d.is_del as isDel from t_department d left join t_department pd on d.parent_id = pd.id left join t_user lu on d.leader_id = lu.id
and d.name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%')
order by d.id

select r.id, r.role_name as roleName, (select count(*) from t_user_role tur where tur.role_id = r.id) as userCount from t_role r
and r.role_name like concat('%', #{roleName}, '%')
order by r.id

select u.id, u.user_name as userName, u.mobile, u.email, d.name as departmentName from t_user_role tur join t_user u on tur.user_id = u.id left join t_department d on u.department_id = d.id where tur.role_id = #{roleId} order by u.id
